notes: §1985:VII.4.4.4 GR7 admits READ ... INTO on two grounds: "If only one record description is subordinate to the file description entry", or "If all record-names associated with file-name-1 and the data item referenced by identifier-1 describe a group item or an elementary alphanumeric item." SequentialIoBinder.BindRead binds the phrase through MoveBinder.BindIntoPhrase, whose first act is StatementValidation.CheckIntoReceiver: a record count of one admits the phrase, otherwise every record (AdmitsIntoRecord) and identifier-1 (AdmitsIntoOperand) must be an alphanumeric group or an elementary item of category alphanumeric (ItemCategory.IsAlphanumericOrNational), else error COBOL1994. There is no edition gate and 1985 needs none: the shapes the 2023 wording adds or excludes (category national, strongly-typed and variable-length groups) cannot be declared at --std 85, where every group is an alphanumeric group, and the record-less FD that IntoPhraseRules.Read also admits is not a 1985 file description. The witness reads into a group from an FD of an elementary PIC X record and a group record. Probed further at --std 85: with two records (PIC X and a group) a numeric, binary, alphabetic, alphanumeric-edited or numeric-edited identifier-1 each draw COBOL1994, as does a level-66 alias of a numeric item; a group, a PIC X item, a reference-modified numeric item and a level-66 THROUGH alias are accepted; with a PIC X and a PIC 9 record every identifier-1 draws COBOL1994; with one numeric record a numeric, binary and numeric-edited identifier-1 are accepted. The message quotes the 2023 rule ("category national") at every edition.

next.reason: 1985: "a. If only one record description is subordinate to the file description entry, or"; 2023: "a) If no record description entry or only one record description is subordinate to the file description entry, or". Same INTO rule, but 2023 adds the case of an FD with no record description entry (see GR-14.9.30.4-6) and admits national elementary items.
